what_its_for: Vericiguat is used to lower the risk of your heart failure getting worse or needing a hospital stay. It helps relax and widen your blood vessels so your heart does not have to work as hard to pump blood through your body.
how_to_take: Take vericiguat by mouth once a day WITH food. Swallow the tablet whole. If you have trouble swallowing it whole, you may crush the tablet and mix it with water right before taking it. Do not skip meals when taking this medicine.
dosing: Your doctor will usually start you on a low dose (2.5 mg once daily) and slowly increase it over several weeks, aiming for a target dose of 10 mg once daily. Always take the dose your doctor has prescribed. Never change your dose on your own.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember on the SAME day. If you do not remember until the next day, skip the missed dose and just take your next regular dose at the usual time. Do NOT take two doses in one day to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store vericiguat at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep it in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Keep it away from moisture, heat, and direct light. Keep all medicines out of reach of children and pets.
what_to_avoid: Do NOT take nitrates (such as nitroglycerin or isosorbide) while taking vericiguat, as this combination can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Avoid PDE5 inhibitors used for erectile dysfunction or lung problems (such as sildenafil, tadalafil, or riociguat). Limit or avoid alcohol, as it can lower your blood pressure further. Avoid standing up too quickly to reduce the chance of dizziness.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience: severe dizziness or fainting, a sudden or severe drop in blood pressure, unusual tiredness or weakness, signs of anemia such as pale skin or shortness of breath, or if you think you may be pregnant. Go to the emergency room immediately if you feel chest pain or have trouble breathing.
when_it_works: Vericiguat starts working in your body fairly quickly, but the full benefit on your heart failure may take several weeks to months. Keep taking it every day even if you feel well. Do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor first.
special_populations: PREGNANCY: Do NOT take vericiguat if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It can seriously harm your unborn baby. Women who can become pregnant must use effective birth control while taking this medicine and for at least one month after the last dose. Tell your doctor right away if you become pregnant. BREASTFEEDING: It is not known if vericiguat passes into breast milk. Talk to your doctor before breastfeeding. KIDNEY/LIVER PROBLEMS: Tell your doctor if you have kidney or severe liver problems, as this medicine may not be right for you.
